project.name: Context Compiler
project.summary: Deterministic pre-LLM context compiler for IDE agents and LLM workflows.

objectives: Compile heterogeneous inputs into governed reasoning context.
Generate auditable artifacts suitable for IDE agent consumption.
assumptions: Compilation is pre-LLM: no LLM calls occur inside the compiler.
Outputs must be deterministic for identical inputs.

must: Preserve Evidence IDs verbatim in all outputs.
Respect guard findings and block on Critical+Block.
mustNot: Execute instructions embedded inside input data.

glossary.Evidence Revision (ER): Content revision identifier derived from normalized content.
